label: TB200 2-port BRI VoIP gateway
description: BRI gateway with 2 ISDN BRI ports (4 B-channels) that bridges ISDN BRI lines to SIP, with no analog FXS/FXO ports and a single 10/100 Mbps LAN port.
notes: Yeastar TB series spec table: TB200 = 2 BRI ports, LAN = 1 x 10/100 Mbps (the TB400 doubles BRI to 4; neither has gigabit). BRI ports are RJ-45 physically but carry ISDN S0/T0 telephony, not Ethernet, so they are excluded from interfaces - this device therefore models exactly one network port. SIP over UDP/TCP/TLS/SRTP, G.711/G.722/G.726/G.729A/GSM/ADPCM, RFC2833/SIP INFO/in-band DTMF, DHCP/DDNS/firewall/static route.
